title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
## An Overview of this role
As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team, you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.
## What you’ll do
• Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM.
• Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences.
• Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production
• Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention
• Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy.
• Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources.
• Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review
## What you’ll bring
• 3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role
• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis
• Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)
• Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost
• Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.
• Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction
• Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills
• Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization
About the Team
The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.
## How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
• Flexible Paid Time Off
• Team Member Resource Groups
• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Growth and Development Fund
• Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Veterinary AI Expert
description:
About CoVet
CoVet is an AI copilot and scribe built to assist veterinary professionals by saving them time and allowing them to focus more on pet care—or even get home on time. We are a small, passionate, and agile team with a strong mission to improve the veterinary industry through innovative technology.
As we scale, we are looking for a forward-thinking Veterinary AI Expert to join our CoVet Medical Team and help us advance both the performance and personalization of our AI solutions.
About the role
As a Veterinary AI Expert, you will combine your veterinary expertise with your passion for AI and technology to shape the future of our AI Copilot. Reporting directly to the CVO, you will work closely with our users to understand their unique workflows, create custom templates and prompt strategies, and collaborate with our technical teams to test, train, and refine new AI models. This role also involves structuring internal systems for testing AI performance, researching emerging solutions in the market, and influencing the next generation of features in the CoVet platform.
You will also support our user community, contribute to research initiatives, and help create educational content that bridges the gap between veterinary practice and AI-driven innovation.
What you'll do
• Develop and customize templates and prompts within the CoVet app tailored to users across diverse veterinary practice areas.
• Design and test new prompting strategies to improve the performance and relevance of the AI Copilot across specialties.
• Collaborate directly with technical teams to provide veterinary insight during the development and refinement of new AI tools and implementations.
• Contribute to the design of internal testing systems to evaluate AI behavior, accuracy, and performance in clinical contexts.
• Research and evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and market solutions to inform product development strategy.
• Occasionally provide expert-level support to users, troubleshoot AI-related issues, and help train users to maximize the value of the Copilot.
• Participate in or co-lead academic and clinical research projects focused on veterinary AI applications.
• Influence the long-term roadmap and enhancements of the CoVet platform with a strong voice for veterinary user needs.
Qualifications
• 3–5 years of experience as a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) in any clinical setting.
• Hands-on or collaborative experience with AI systems, prompt engineering, or machine learning tools (formal or informal).
• Experience with software testing, QA, or structured evaluation of digital tools is a plus.
• Background in customer support or client-facing roles is considered an asset.
Skills:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.
• Comfort navigating ambiguity and developing systems or processes from the ground up.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills—especially the ability to convey complex tech ideas clearly.
• Self-driven and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.
• Curiosity and a strong interest in the intersection of technology and medicine.
Education:
• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM or equivalent) degree required.
Why Join Us?
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• A dynamic and creative remote work environment.
• Opportunity to work in an exciting, fast-paced industry and help shape the future of veterinary technology.
If you are a passionate veterinarian with a keen interest in AI and technology, and you're excited about making a significant impact on the veterinary industry, we'd love to hear from you!
CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process to accommodate individual needs.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
## About the role
This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against.
If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you.
## What you'll build
## The runtime
Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations.
Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity.
## Reliability
Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation.
Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown.
## Tools, context, and memory
Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems.
Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation.
## Evaluation and observability
Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths.
Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results.
Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow.
## Security
Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required.
## Delivery and leadership
Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks.
Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria.
## What you bring
8+ years of software engineering, including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work.
2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain, and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved.
Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware.
Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls.
Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation.
Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture.
Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.
Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them.
Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing.
Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them.
Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision.

title: Healthcare Data Scientist (Remote, International)
description:
You'll work on customer projects, where hospitals, payers and pharma companies use our software on their own data. Your work includes:
• Model training: fine-tune LLM and NLP models for entity extraction, assertion status and relation extraction on clinical notes, using Spark NLP for Healthcare and open-source Python libraries.
• Extraction pipelines: pull structured facts from clinical notes, pathology and radiology reports, scanned PDFs and DICOM images, and remove PHI from them.
• Data harmonization: map what you extract to the OMOP common data model, FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC) to build each patient's journey.
• Validation: test models for bias, overfitting and drift before and after they go live.
• Customer work: scope problems with customer data teams, explain results to clinicians and engineers, and write up what you built.
## Requirements: 5+ industry years on clinical data
## You need all of these:
• At least 5 years as a hands-on data scientist or ML engineer in industry, delivering projects that went into production. Academic work alone, or apps built only by calling an LLM API, isn't enough.
• Proven work on clinical data: clinical notes, pathology or radiology reports, medical images, EHR records, or OMOP and FHIR datasets. Experience limited to claims or billing data doesn't qualify.
• Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain / LangSmith, Spark NLP, or related open-source libraries.
• Proven working knowledge of current software development tools such as GitHub, Docker, AWS / Azure, Claude Code / Codex.
• Clear written and spoken English, since you'll present to customer teams every week.
PhD or MD and Healthcare AI Industry Experience Preferred
These put your application near the top of the pile:
• A PhD in computer science, biomedical informatics, biostatistics or a related field, or an MD, plus industry experience after it.
• Work at a clinical NLP or healthcare AI company, a cloud healthcare AI service, or the data science team of a health system, payer or pharma company.
• Hands-on use of Spark NLP, Healthcare NLP or our Medical LLM.
• Peer-reviewed papers or shared-task results in clinical NLP or medical imaging, for example at AMIA, ACL, NAACL or EMNLP.
• De-identification, OMOP ETL, or work with research clinical datasets such as MIMIC.
## Long-term freelance contract worldwide
You'll work remotely as an independent contractor on a long-term contract of 30 to 40 hours a week. This isn't a full-time employment role, and we contract with individuals only, not agencies or teams. You can apply from any country except those where US sanctions or our own policy prevent us from contracting.
John Snow Labs is profitable and has never taken venture or debt financing, so we hire for multi-year work.
Apply yourself: we don't review submissions from recruiters or agencies. Your cover letter should include the words "John Snow Labs", the country you live in now, one clinical data project you delivered (the dataset, your role, the model or method, the result), and links to your GitHub or papers. Applications without these are hard for us to assess, so we may not reply to them.
John Snow Labs is looking for senior healthcare data scientists to build clinical LLM and NLP pipelines for more than 500 enterprise customers in healthcare and life sciences. This is a remote contract of at least 30 hours a week, open to individuals in most countries.
You'll join a team that works across 28 countries, where 33% of members hold a PhD or MD and 75% hold at least a master's degree. Our software includes Healthcare NLP, Medical LLM, visual language models, multimodal de-identification, OMOP harmonization, and the Patient Journey Intelligence platform.
John Snow Labs has won 50+ industry awards, including Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Customer Value Leadership Award for Healthcare Large Language Models, and was ranked first among 190+ companies by MarketsandMarkets for NLP in Healthcare and Life Sciences.

title: Data Analyst - Platform Migration
description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.
Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.
You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.
## What you'll do
## Profile and map
Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.
Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.
Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.
## Migrate and prove
Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.
Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.
Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.
## Integrations and commercial data
Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and their migration status.
Map products, price books and contract terms, and help Finance reconcile billing between each acquired platform and Veremark.
## Report
Own the migration dashboards for every integration in progress and contribute to the Programme Director's weekly update.
Give Customer Success and Sales the client data they need to plan each move.
Use AI to work faster: query data with prompts, draft and review SQL, generate first-pass mappings and documentation, and automate routine checks, always verifying results against the source.
## Make each integration faster
Build a reusable library of profiling and reconciliation SQL, mapping templates and sign-off checklists.
Feed what you learn back into the integration playbook after each deal.
Where needed, review a target company's data before a deal closes, so we know what we're taking on.
## Must have
3+ years as a data analyst, with hands-on work on at least one data migration, platform consolidation or system implementation. Tell us what you moved, how much, and what went wrong.
Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregation, used to profile unfamiliar data and reconcile a source against a target.
Confident with AI and new tools: you already use AI in your daily work, for example querying data with prompts, drafting and reviewing SQL with an LLM, or using AI features in your BI tool. You know where it saves time, and you check what it produces against the data.
Data mapping and validation: you've written field-level mappings, tested migrated data against them and investigated the differences.
Reporting: dashboards in Looker, Metabase or similar that non-technical people use.
Enough BA craft to work with the product team: documenting current and future state, writing clear requirements, and supporting UAT.
Clear communication: you can explain a data problem to a client success manager and a finance lead.
Comfortable working to a playbook: you follow an agreed process and flag what doesn't fit, rather than reinventing it, and help improve it after each deal.
## Nice to have
## Python for data cleansing and profiling
Experience with billing, pricing or contract data, or with systems like NetSuite or a CRM
Background in HR tech, background screening, fintech or another regulated industry
Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse or Bullhorn, and with APIs and webhooks
Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit evidence
Previous post-acquisition or post-merger integration work
We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.
We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.
And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.
## What We Offer:
• A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
• Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
• Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
• Remote work
• A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way
Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.
We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.
We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.
But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

title: Data Engineer
description:
## The Team You'll Join
First American Title Insurance Company, one of the nation's largest title insurers, provides comprehensive title insurance coverage and professional services for residential, commercial, and new construction purchases, along with refinances and equity loans. Join the global title operations team that supports title and escrow operations across the company, helping create a smoother path through each transaction for the customers, partners, and communities we serve. You’ll work alongside talented operations professionals and business partners to support title and escrow teams, improve the customer experience, help solve complex challenges, and move the industry forward. Along the way, you’ll be part of a supportive, relationship-driven culture where people are invested in your growth and success.
## The Impact You'll Make
We're looking for a Data Engineer II to design, build and run scalable cloud data solutions. These solutions feed analytics, real-time applications, AI/ML and our enterprise data products. You'll build reliable pipelines, reusable frameworks and low-latency operational data stores, and you'll use AI-assisted tools to deliver faster without lowering quality. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to understand needs, align priorities and deliver business value.
## Our tech stack
Our platform is built primarily on Azure Databricks. We use Delta Lake, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Auto Loader, Databricks SQL and Declarative Automation Bundles. Experience with other modern data platforms, such as Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift, is a plus.
## How you'll contribute
• Design, develop, test and document data pipelines, data solutions and supporting applications.
• Build and support batch and streaming pipelines that integrate and transform data from multiple sources and technologies into consistent, trusted datasets. Sources include databases, cloud storage, SaaS applications, APIs, files and event streams.
• Contribute to the design and implementation of data architectures under senior engineering guidance.
• Build reusable frameworks driven by metadata and configuration for ingestion, transformation and reconciliation. Use CDC, incremental processing, SCD patterns and idempotent backfills.
• Tune distributed processing, SQL, storage and compute for performance and cost.
• Build and support low-latency operational data solutions on managed PostgreSQL platforms such as Lakebase, serving curated data to applications, APIs and AI agents.
• Model data for analytics and AI, including semantic layers, feature pipelines and data preparation for RAG.
• Ensure data is accurate and secure through testing, validation, data quality monitoring, access control, lineage and PII protection.
• Troubleshoot and resolve data issues. Drive process improvements that automate manual work, optimize data delivery and improve scalability and reliability.
• Build CI/CD pipelines and deployments as code, and use AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery while validating all generated output.
• Monitor production pipelines and data products using observability, alerting and operational dashboards to ensure reliability and SLA adherence.
• Share knowledge with teammates, participate in code reviews and contribute to Agile delivery.
## What you'll bring
Required
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 3–5 years of data engineering experience on modern cloud data platforms.
• At least 2 years of hands-on Databricks experience, including Delta Lake (MERGE and upserts, schema evolution, time travel, Change Data Feed and table optimization), notebooks, jobs and Databricks SQL.
• Advanced SQL and strong Python/PySpark skills, with experience tuning performance.
• Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse design.
• Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouses that integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources, including CDC, SCD and incremental processing patterns.
• Experience designing and supporting operational data stores such as PostgreSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Lakebase, Aurora PostgreSQL or similar platforms.
• Hands-on relational database and OLTP experience, including schema design, indexing, transactions and query tuning.
• Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and Agile delivery.
• Azure cloud experience.
Preferred
• Experience with AI/ML data workloads, including feature engineering, MLflow, Vector Search or AI Functions.
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools. Our team uses GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and Databricks Genie Code, and experience with any of them is a plus.
• Experience with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Auto Loader, Declarative Automation Bundles and Unity Catalog governance features such as row filters, column masks and lineage.
• Hands-on Lakebase experience, including synced tables, branching, autoscaling, point-in-time restore and integration with Databricks Apps or online feature serving.
• Experience with Delta Sharing, Lakehouse Federation, event streaming, infrastructure-as-code or production observability platforms.
• Experience with other modern data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
• T-SQL experience, including migration of legacy SQL Server workloads to modern cloud data platforms.
How you work
• You communicate clearly in writing and conversation and build consensus across teams.
• You're a self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• You manage multiple priorities effectively and respond quickly to emerging problems.
• You solve problems creatively and know when to leverage the expertise of senior colleagues.
This position will be accepting applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled
## Pay, Benefits, and Support
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 AnnuallyThis hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward.
## About First American

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
About TTS-US: Founded in 2011, Toyota Tsusho Systems US, Inc. (TTS-US) is a Toyota group company that develops IT solutions wherever global businesses operate. Transforming into a technology and mobility company, TTS-US and its global affiliates are helping establish a secure and resilient Toyota global value chain.
## Who We’re Looking For
Our team is looking for a highly motivated, hands-on leader to fill the role of Security Architect. This role will be the security authority for the cloud environments with a focus on Microsoft Azure.
The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that security tools are architected and integrated to protect the environment appropriately, that security governance is performed consistently, and that firewall and network access rules are reviewed and approved under strict separation of duties. You will lead the security assessment and drive the security roadmap from discovery through sustainment.
## What you’ll be doing
## Security Tool Architecture & Integration
• Architect TFS enterprise security tooling in Azure, including Orca CSPM, CrowdStrike EDR, Okta / Entra ID identity integration, ColorTokens micro-segmentation and SIEM log forwarding (direct or via Cribl / Event Hub)
• Decide where TFS enterprise tooling is required versus where Azure-native controls (Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps, Azure Policy, Microsoft Sentinel) are sufficient, eliminating duplicate capability and documenting the rationale
• Design secure patterns for ephemeral, IaC-built workloads, such as building EDR agents into image pipelines and automatically removing destroyed hosts from security consoles
## Network Security & Firewall Governance
• Own the review and approval of firewall rule changes for ingress, egress and east-west traffic (Azure Firewall, Front Door / WAF), keeping approval separate from implementation
• Lead recurring firewall allow-list and egress reviews, endpoints and run-level egress IP ranges, and ensure every rule has a business justification and owner
• Define the long-term hub-and-spoke network security architecture, segmentation between low, high and production run levels, and the model for central TFS Network Security governance
• Ensure no storage, API or management endpoint is publicly exposed without WAF or authentication protection
## Identity & Privileged Access
• Set the target IAM standard for the tenant, including Entra ID / Okta integration, PIM and just-in-time access, Conditional Access, break-glass accounts and compensating controls where geo-location is unreliable
• Assist IAM in monitoring the lifecycle of member, guest, third-party (e.g., TTEC), test and service accounts, including permanent assignments, legacy accounts, service principals and secrets, with recurring access reviews
## Logging, Detection & Response
• Architect security telemetry flows from Entra ID, Azure Activity, Firewall, WAF, Defender, Dynamics and Azure DevOps to the TFS SIEM / SOC, and define SOC use cases, alerting baselines and tuning ownership
## Governance, Risk & Assessment
• Lead structured security assessments across identity, logging, posture, network, data, SaaS integrations, endpoint and governance domains, scoring maturity (0–4) and producing executive heat maps, a redline register and a prioritized remediation roadmap
• Identify and escalate cyber redlines (e.g., privileged everyday accounts, admin access without MFA, unprotected public exposure)
• Run the security review gate for new SaaS and application integrations (e.g., Alfa, RapidCX, banking partners), maintaining an authoritative integration register and controlling scope creep
• Oversee validation before go-live, including WAF and application penetration testing, control validation, detection testing, DR testing and access reviews, and give the formal security sign-off with residual risks accepted by named owners
## Requirements
•Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; advanced degree (preferred)
•8+ years in information security, including 5+ years in security architecture and at least 3 years designing and securing Microsoft Azure environments
•Deep hands-on knowledge of Azure security: Entra ID, PIM, Conditional Access, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Firewall, Front Door / WAF, Key Vault and hub-and-spoke landing zones
•Proven experience architecting and integrating enterprise security tools such as CSPM (e.g., Orca), EDR (e.g., CrowdStrike), SIEM / log pipelines (e.g., Cribl), IAM (e.g., Okta) and micro-segmentation
•Strong track record of firewall rule governance, including rule review, change approval and separation of duties for ingress, egress and east-west traffic
•Experience applying frameworks such as the Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, CIS, NIST CSF or ISO 27001, including breaking standards down into enforceable controls
•Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Bicep / Terraform) and of securing PaaS, SaaS and Dynamics / Power Platform environments
•Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, AZ-500, SC-100 or CCNP Security are highly desirable
•Strong leadership and communication skills, with experience guiding cross-functional and vendor teams and explaining technical risk to executives

description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
## About the Role:
The DevOps Engineer helps build, operate, and improve the automation and delivery systems that enable engineering teams to provision, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support applications and infrastructure. The role applies established DevOps practices to improve delivery consistency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen reliability and security.
This is a career-growth individual-contributor role. The engineer owns well-scoped changes and project components affecting the team or department, resolves routine to moderately complex deployment and infrastructure issues, and contributes to improvements in CI/CD, configuration, monitoring, and release processes. Work is performed with general direction and appropriate review, with risks and blockers raised proactively.
## What You’ll Do:
• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipeline components, deployment configurations, build steps, and release automation using established patterns.
• Automate routine operational and delivery tasks using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
• Use infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management tools to make reviewed, repeatable changes to cloud and infrastructure environments.
• Support reusable deployment patterns for cloud and containerized workloads, including Docker and Kubernetes-based environments.
• Help maintain infrastructure modules, environment configuration, access patterns, secrets integrations, and policy checks.
• Contribute to secure delivery practices such as secret detection, protected branches, merge-request controls, artifact management, and automated validation.
• Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, dashboards, alerts, and basic service-health signals using established team standards.
• Investigate pipeline failures, deployment issues, configuration drift, monitoring gaps, and routine infrastructure problems using logs, metrics, traces, and documented procedures.
• Resolve root causes of assigned problems when possible and escalate issues when they exceed documented procedures or create material operational risk.
• Participate in change planning, testing, peer review, rollout validation, and rollback activities.
• Document reusable procedures, troubleshooting steps, configuration changes, and operational learnings.
• Collaborate with development, operations, cloud, security, and application teams to gather requirements and communicate status clearly.
• Participate in retrospectives, incident follow-up, and continuous-improvement work.
• Contribute to reusable delivery and infrastructure capabilities while following established platform patterns, standards, and change-management practices.
• Use supported self-service workflows and document deviations from standard patterns for review.
• Escalate complex infrastructure, security, reliability, and architecture decisions to the appropriate senior engineer, platform owner, DevOps lead, or service owner.
• Respect service ownership: delivery teams remain accountable for their applications and service-level operations; this role supports the tooling and infrastructure that enable them.
## What You’ll Need:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, software engineering, SRE, or a related discipline; experience is a guideline, not a barrier to entry.
• Working knowledge of source control, software delivery concepts, CI/CD pipelines, and system administration.
• Working knowledge of Python, Bash, or a comparable scripting language.
• Experience using infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management tools such as Terraform or Ansible under review.
• Understanding of containers, cloud platforms, deployment workflows, monitoring, and reliability practices.
• Ability to follow runbooks and established procedures while recognizing when a situation requires clarification or escalation.
• Ability to troubleshoot moderate problems, identify contributing factors, and communicate status, risks, and blockers proactively.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
• Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
## Bonus Points:
• Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or a similar delivery platform.
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or cloud-native deployment patterns.
• Familiarity with AWS, GCP, Azure, or another public or hybrid cloud platform.
• Exposure to Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

title: AI Video Creator
description:
Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.
## 📅 Date de démarrage
## ASAP
## 🏡 Type de contrat
## CDI ou Freelance à temps plein
## Séniorité : Confirmé(e)
## 🌍 Localisation
## 100% Remote (Europe)
## 💼 Description du poste
DotWorld fait grandir un portefeuille d'une dizaine de SaaS par abonnement, utilisés par des millions de personnes. Notre croissance repose en grande partie sur l'acquisition payante - Meta, TikTok, Google, OpenAI Ads, et bientôt YouTube et d'autres canaux - où la créa est le premier levier de performance.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, même la meilleure vidéo finit par s'essouffler : à force d'être vue par la même audience, ses résultats stagnent puis chutent. C'est la fatigue créative. Pour continuer à scaler, il nous faut donc renouveler nos créas en permanence, avec de nouveaux concepts et de nouvelles variantes à tester.
C'est là que tu interviens. En tant qu'AI Video Ads Creator, tu produis des publicités vidéo 100 % orientées performance avec les meilleurs outils de génération vidéo par IA, du brief jusqu'au montage final prêt à diffuser - y compris des vidéos UGC IA, portées par des personnages générés par IA.
Tu travailles sur plusieurs produits et plusieurs plateformes en parallèle, avec un retour direct sur l'impact de chaque vidéo grâce aux données de performance.
## 👥 Description de l'équipe
Tu rejoins l'équipe Growth, pilotée par Bastien BRICOUT, notre Chief Growth Officer, qui sera ton manager dans un premier temps. À terme, tu seras rattaché(e) à notre futur(e) Creative Strategist, en cours de recrutement.
Au quotidien, tu travailles main dans la main avec :
Les creative strategists, qui définissent les angles et les briefs
Les media buyers, qui testent les créas et te renvoient les résultats - notamment Chloé sur Meta et Tom sur TikTok, qui assurent ton suivi opérationnel
Clément, AI Video Ads Creator déjà en place, avec qui tu formes un binôme et te répartis les projets par produit et par plateforme
## 📂 Tes responsabilités
## Production de vidéos IA
Transformer les briefs des creative strategists en vidéos : certains sont très détaillés, plan par plan, d'autres plus ouverts - à toi alors de construire le hook, le fil conducteur et la fin
Produire des vidéos publicitaires avec les outils de génération IA (Seedance, Higgsfield, Kling, Veo 3…), dont des vidéos UGC IA
Monter les vidéos de bout en bout : rythme, hook, sous-titres, sound design, formats par plateforme (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)
## Concepts et déclinaisons
Produire environ 10 à 30 nouveaux concepts par semaine, selon les besoins
Décliner chaque concept en plusieurs variantes (hooks, personnages, accroches, langues) pour alimenter les tests
Gérer plusieurs produits et briefs en parallèle, en tenant les délais
## Itération et veille
Exploiter les retours de performance des media buyers pour améliorer chaque itération
Suivre les trends des plateformes et l'évolution des outils IA, et proposer de nouveaux formats à tester
## ⭐ Ton profil
## Expérience
## Séniorité : Confirmé(e)
2-3 ans d'expérience en création de vidéos publicitaires générées par IA - ton portfolio comptera plus que le nombre d'années
Idéalement, une expérience multi-clients ou multi-produits en simultané (agence, freelance, studio)
Habitude de travailler avec des creative strategists et des media buyers, à partir d'un brief et de données de performance
Un portfolio de vidéos ads est indispensable
## Compétences techniques
De vraies bases en montage vidéo, au-delà du prompt : savoir corriger un détail toi-même sans tout regénérer, et avoir l'œil pour reconnaître une vidéo qui fonctionne
Maîtrise pratique des outils de génération vidéo IA du moment (Seedance, Higgsfield, Kling, Veo 3)
## Premiere Pro
Déclinaisons multilingues via les outils IA (ElevenLabs, HeyGen)
Culture des trends TikTok, Reels et Shorts
Bonus : une expérience sur des SaaS ou apps par abonnement, des notions de motion design
## Compétences interpersonnelles
## Rapidité d'exécution
Organisation solide sur plusieurs projets en parallèle
Ouverture au feedback des media buyers, et envie d'itérer à partir des données
## Compétences linguistiques
Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale
Anglais niveau B2 minimum - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement
## ✅ Les avantages du poste
Un volume de production rare : une dizaine de produits, plusieurs plateformes, des tests en continu
Un retour direct sur l'impact de tes vidéos grâce aux données de performance des media buyers
La liberté d'expérimenter les derniers outils et formats IA
Des outils internes déjà en place, pour produire plus vite
Un binôme déjà en place pour une prise en main rapide
## 👣 Les défis du poste
Une cadence de production soutenue : 10 à 30 concepts par semaine, chacun décliné en hooks et en langues, avec des délais serrés et plusieurs produits en parallèle
Quand un concept ne convertit pas, on repart d'une page blanche : il faut aimer tester de nouvelles idées
Une organisation en construction : notre Creative Strategist, arrive bientôt - d'ici là, tu avances avec Bastien, Chloé et Tom
## 📋 Notre processus de recrutement
Merci de joindre à ta candidature ton portfolio de vidéos ads, en précisant pour chaque vidéo les outils utilisés et ton rôle (génération, montage, concept). Des créas fictives sont les bienvenues : ce qui compte, c'est ton process et ton rendu. Sans portfolio, nous ne pourrons pas étudier ta candidature.
Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min
Étude de cas à la maision et restituion avec notre Chief Growth Officer Bastien et à un membre de l'équipe (Chloé, Tom ou Clément)
Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo
## Prise de références
## ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld
Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.
## Notre approche
Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.
## Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort
Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans
## Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante
Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.
## Une culture d'excellence
Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.
## Et la suite ?
Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.
## 🌿 Environnement de travail
Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.
Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.
Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.
Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.
## 👥 Diversité
DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.
## ⭐ Nos avantages RH
🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.
☕ Budget coworking Si tu préfères bosser hors de chez toi, on prend en charge ton espace de coworking à hauteur de 200 euros par mois pour plus de confort et de focus.
🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.
⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.
🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.
🖥️ Budget équipement On te donne un budget pour t'équiper avec tout ce qu'il te faut : ordinateur portable, bureau, chaise, écran, casque… tout pour être au top !
🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.
## 🌻 Nos valeurs
PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.
OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.
INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.
GROWTH"Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
## Founding Full-Stack Engineer
Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.
## The opportunity
Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.
We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.
## About us
planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.
## What you'll own
The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.
Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.
Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.
Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.
Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.
The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.
You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.
## How we build
Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.
We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.
We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.
There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.
## What you'll bring
Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.
Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.
Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.
Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.
Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.
Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.
Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.
Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.
## What you'll get
Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.
A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.
## A real problem worth solving.
We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.
Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.
## Competitive pay + VSOP.
## The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)
## Send your CV.
Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.
## Meet our CEO and selected investors.
More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

## About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build and maintain production web applications across a modern frontend, backend, database, and cloud stack.
This is a hands-on development role for someone who can own a slice of the product across both UI and API. You’ll work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, relational and graph databases, multi-service architecture, real-time functionality, and Azure infrastructure.

• Work with Framer Motion and Socket.IO.
• Write frontend tests using Vitest + Testing Library.

## Backend Development

• Work with Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2 / SQLModel, Alembic, Celery, Redis, and uv.

• Work with real-time technologies such as Socket.IO / WebRTC or telephony platforms such as Telnyx or similar.

• Comfortable with App Router, server/client boundaries, and data-fetching using TanStack Query or equivalent.
• Strong Python and FastAPI experience, or Django/Flask at a similar depth.
• Experience with typed schemas, async I/O, authentication, and background jobs.
• Strong relational modeling and migration experience using SQLAlchemy/Alembic or equivalent.

## Job Title: Data Engineer

## About the Role
Our client is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the business.
This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep experience with modern data stacks, and a passion for building clean, reliable, and high-performance data systems. The Data Engineer will ensure data flows seamlessly from source systems into warehouses, dashboards, and downstream applications while maintaining high standards for quality, governance, and scalability.
The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver trustworthy and actionable data.
## Responsibilities
## Pipeline Development & Data Integration
• Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, or Scala
• Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools
• Ingest structured and unstructured data from APIs, SaaS platforms, databases, files, and streaming systems
• Develop scalable connectors and automated ingestion workflows
## Data Warehousing & Modeling
• Manage and optimize cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift
• Design scalable schemas using star and snowflake modeling techniques
• Implement partitioning, clustering, indexing, and performance optimization strategies
• Build clean, analytics-ready datasets for business intelligence and reporting use cases
## Data Quality, Governance & Reliability
• Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, logging, and monitoring to ensure data integrity

• Monitor pipeline health and proactively resolve failures or inconsistencies
## Streaming & Real-Time Data Processing

• Monitor streaming infrastructure and optimize throughput and reliability

• Partner closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable datasets
• Support dashboard and reporting initiatives across Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
• Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and models
• Maintain clear technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, and workflows
## Infrastructure, DevOps & Automation
• Containerize data services using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes when applicable
• Automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
• Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
• Continuously optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud costs
## What Makes You a Perfect Fit
• Passionate about building clean, reliable, and scalable data systems
• Strong debugging and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail
• Balance of software engineering discipline and analytical thinking
• Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Proactive communicator who takes ownership of data quality and reliability
## Required Experience & Skills
• 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Back-End Engineering, or Data Infrastructure roles
## • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
• Experience with at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
• Hands-on experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect

• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
## Preferred Experience & Skills
• Experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation management
• Streaming and event-driven data pipeline experience (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)

• Background in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or enterprise SaaS

## What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
A Data Engineer’s day revolves around maintaining reliable pipelines, improving data quality, and enabling teams with scalable access to trustworthy data. You will:

• Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for APIs, SaaS platforms, and operational databases

## Job Title: Financial Analyst / Data Analyst
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for reporting deadlines, month-end cycles, and strategic projects)
## About the Role
Our client is seeking a Financial Analyst / Data Analyst to build financial models, analyze operational and financial performance, and deliver data-driven insights that support strategic decision-making.
This role combines financial analysis with modern data analytics, requiring strong quantitative skills, business acumen, and proficiency with reporting and BI tools. The Financial Analyst / Data Analyst serves as the bridge between raw data and executive strategy — ensuring reporting is accurate, actionable, and aligned with business goals.
The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming complex datasets into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.
## Responsibilities
## Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis
• Build and maintain 3-statement financial models including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections
• Create scenario, sensitivity, break-even, ROI, IRR, and valuation analyses to evaluate risks and opportunities
• Support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning initiatives
• Analyze financial performance and identify trends impacting profitability, growth, and operational efficiency
## Data Analysis & Reporting
• Query SQL databases and work with large structured datasets
• Clean, transform, and validate data using Excel, Python, R, or related tools
• Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance against budgets and forecasts
• Develop recurring and ad hoc reports for finance, operations, and leadership teams
## Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence
• Build and maintain KPI dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI tools
• Ensure reporting consistency, data integrity, and standardized metric definitions across departments
• Create executive-ready visualizations and reporting packages for leadership and board presentations
• Improve visibility into operational and financial performance through automated reporting systems
## Forecasting, Planning & Business Support
• Partner with FP&A, finance, sales, and operations teams to refine forecasts and budgets
• Incorporate real-time business trends into rolling forecasts and scenario planning
• Support strategic initiatives through financial and operational analysis
• Translate business needs into measurable KPIs and analytical frameworks
## Data Governance & Accuracy
• Validate and reconcile data sources to ensure accuracy and reliability
• Document methodologies, assumptions, and reporting processes for transparency and repeatability
• Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and data quality
• Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and analysis workflows
## Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with leadership and stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, and strategy teams
• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Support decision-making with concise, actionable insights backed by data and financial analysis
## What Makes You a Perfect Fit
• Strong analytical thinker capable of turning complex data into simple, actionable insights
• Highly detail-oriented with strong standards for accuracy and consistency
• Excellent communicator comfortable presenting to executives and stakeholders
• Curious and proactive in identifying trends, opportunities, and operational risks
• Strong balance of technical analysis and business understanding
## Required Experience & Skills
• 2+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business intelligence, or data analytics
• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH, lookup formulas, and modeling
• Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing datasets
• Experience preparing variance analyses, forecasting models, and management reports
• Ability to work with large datasets and synthesize findings clearly
## Preferred Experience & Skills
• Experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and data transformation
• Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
• Industry experience in SaaS, finance, healthcare, or professional services
• Experience extracting data from ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle
• Knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and operational KPI frameworks
• Exposure to automation or advanced reporting workflows
## What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
A Financial Analyst / Data Analyst’s day revolves around transforming financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. You will:
• Pull, clean, and validate data from SQL databases, ERP systems, or reporting platforms
• Update financial models and run scenario analyses based on the latest business performance
• Prepare variance analyses explaining deviations from forecast or budget
• Build and maintain dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into KPIs
• Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret data and support strategic decisions
• Document assumptions, methodologies, and reporting logic to ensure consistency and transparency
In essence: you ensure leadership always has accurate, timely, and actionable insights to guide business decisions and long-term strategy.
## Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)
• Forecast and model accuracy within agreed variance thresholds
• Timely delivery of monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting
• Reliability and usability of dashboards and reporting tools
• Improved data quality and reporting consistency
• Actionable insights that support strategic and operational decisions
• Positive stakeholder feedback on reporting clarity and analytical support

Post-editors review and correct transcripts of recordings in their native language.
Languages needed: North Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Eastern Armenian, Kabuverdianu (Cape Verdean Creole), Central Khmer, Min Nan (Taiwanese Hokkien, Taipei), Breton, Singapore Colloquial English (Singlish)

• Native speaker with at least C1 English
• Excellent attention to detail

title: Data Science & AI Graduate
description:
## About the Role
We are seeking an exceptional graduate to join Stalis as a generalist across our technical and operational functions. You will work closely with teams across the business, developing a deep understanding of how healthcare data moves through our systems and identifying opportunities to apply programming, modern tooling, and AI to improve how we work. Over time, as Stalis’s data intelligence capability matures, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to machine learning and analytics work that shapes our next generation of products.
## The Reality of the Work
This is a broad role, and not every task will be glamorous. Much of the early value comes from genuinely understanding how work is done at Stalis today - which means doing the work, not just observing it. Some of your time will be spent on detailed, careful data tasks that are essential to our clients. The opportunity is to use that understanding as the foundation for automation, improvement, and new capability. The best ideas will come from the ground up, and we expect you to find them.
## What you’ll actually do
• Work alongside our data migration and engineering teams on live client projects, contributing to the day-to-day delivery of healthcare data work.
• Identify inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and fragile processes - and build the scripts, tools, and small systems that fix them.
• Write and maintain code, primarily in Python & SQL, to automate workflows, process data, and support internal operations.
• Apply and experiment with AI tooling - LLMs, embeddings, classifiers - to problems across the business where they add real value, and be honest about where they don’t.
• Communicate your work clearly, in writing and in person, to colleagues who are not data scientists - so that your improvements get adopted rather than sidelined.
• Over time, contribute to Stalis’s emerging data science and machine learning capability, including schema mapping, clinical data analytics, and data products.
## Requirements
## Who we’re looking for
You will need most, if not all, of the following:
Academic background. A strong degree from a top university in a quantitative or technical discipline - physics, engineering, computer science, mathematics, or similar.
Genuine technical aptitude. Comfortable writing code, and keen to write more of it. We are not looking for a particular stack or prior industry experience, but you should already be writing code for fun, coursework, or projects, and be able to pick up new tools quickly.
AI-savvy. Fluent with modern AI tools as a day-to-day part of how you work and think. You know what LLMs are good at, what they’re bad at, and how to use them without being credulous about their output.
Self-directed. You find problems, scope them yourself, and take them to a useful end state without being spoon-fed tasks. You are comfortable operating under ambiguity and choosing what to work on when it isn’t obvious.
Discerning and pragmatic. You can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one worth a fifty-line script today. You don’t gold-plate.
Strong communicator, in writing especially. You can write a short memo or a handover document that brings people along. In a small, distributed business, this matters more than people think.
Emotionally intelligent. Improvements to how people work can feel like criticism, even when they aren’t. You can read a room, win people over, and work collaboratively with colleagues who know things you don’t.
Domain-humble. You are curious about how Stalis works today before you try to change it. You understand that experienced colleagues know things that aren’t written down, and you treat that knowledge as an asset.
## Benefits
## What you’ll get from us
• Unusual breadth of exposure for a graduate role - you will see how a specialist healthcare data company actually runs, from the data up.
• A path into machine learning and data science work as Stalis’s data intelligence capability develops, with real problems and real data to work on.
• Direct access to senior colleagues, reporting to the Head of Data Science, and genuine influence over how the company evolves.
• A role that will grow as quickly as you do.
