title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
Overview
## Impact the Moment
We're looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to join our AI Enablement team; someone who embeds directly with business teams to understand how they work today, and helps them reimagine those workflows using AI. This is fundamentally an engineering role, but the job isn't to build a custom solution for every workflow you touch. It is to turn what you learn into repeatable patterns, reusable proof of concepts, and skills that let teams keep moving on their own.
In the near term, you'll help support the rollout of our enterprise AI tools across the organization, working through the technical details of onboarding and adoption. But the real mandate is longer term and bigger: helping the company become genuinely AI native by continuously finding where AI tools, existing ones and new ones as they arrive, can meaningfully change how business teams get work done, and then building the patterns that make those changes scale.
This role sits between engineering and the business. You need enough technical depth to build real prototypes and understand how these tools work under the hood, and enough business fluency to sit with a team, understand their workflow, and help them see a genuinely different way of working. We're also looking for someone who is an expert-level practitioner of our enterprise AI tools, especially M365 Copilot and Claude, not just someone who knows about them. You should be able to get more out of these tools than most people at the company, and use that depth to show others what's actually possible.
This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.
## What You'll Do:
## Enterprise Tool Rollout (Near Term)
• Support the technical rollout of our enterprise AI tools: onboarding, integrations, access issues, and the practical problems that come up as teams start using it.
• Build early proof of concepts with pilot teams that show what the tool can do for their specific workflows.
• Partner with other functions like cybersecurity, legal, data ethics and training on the rollout so the technical details don't become adoption blockers.
Workflow Reimagination & Forward Deployment (Ongoing)
• Embed with business teams to understand their workflows in depth, and identify where AI can change how the work gets done, not just speed up one step in an old process.
• Design and build proof of concepts that show a team a genuinely new way of working, then help them carry it into everyday use.
• Identify and enable foundational capabilities like connectors and any other integrations.
• Turn what works into repeatable patterns: reusable prompt libraries, skills, plugins, workflow templates, integration recipes, and reference builds that other teams can pick up without needing a dedicated engineer.
• Feed what you learn from the field back into company-wide best practices, training, and governance, in partnership with the rest of the AI Enablement team.
• Teach and transfer knowledge, not just solutions: help teams build enough AI fluency to extend and adapt what you've built themselves.
• Scout new AI tools and capabilities as they become available within the company, and form a clear point of view on what's worth enabling and where.
• Guide teams toward optimal, cost-efficient use of enterprise AI tools: right-sized models, well-scoped prompts, and workflows that get strong results without wasting spend.
## Who You Are
• An expert-level practitioner of enterprise AI tools like M365 Copilot and Claude: you know these tools inside and out, push them well past basic use cases, and can teach others how to do the same.
• A real engineering background: you can prototype, script, and build integrations yourself, not just advise on what's technically possible.
• A product mindset: you default to designing and building for reuse and self-service rather than one-off solutions for a single team.
• Comfortable embedding with a business team long enough to deeply understand their workflow, but disciplined about generalizing what you build so it outlives that one engagement.
• Strong proof-of-concept instincts: you'd rather get something real in front of users quickly than over-engineer before you know it's worth building.
• Curious and fast-moving with new AI tools and capabilities, comfortable evaluating and adopting new ones as the landscape shifts.
• A strong communicator who can sit with a non-technical business team and guide them through rethinking how they work.
## What You'll Learn & How You'll Grow
• Deep, hands-on exposure to how a wide range of business workflows actually work across the company, and practice redesigning them around AI.
• Practical expertise in building reusable AI patterns, accelerators, and evaluation approaches that scale beyond a single engagement.
• Experience as a forward deployed engineer, a skill set that combines technical depth with business fluency and is in high demand.
• The chance to help shape the technical patterns and playbook that the entire AI Enablement function relies on as it grows.
## What Success Looks Like
• Business teams have genuinely reimagined workflows using AI, not just automated a step of their old process.
• A growing library of reusable AI enablement patterns and proof of concepts is adopted across the company, reducing the need for one-off engineering support.
• The enterprise AI tool rollout lands smoothly, and the technical foundation is in place for the broader, longer-term AI enablement mandate.
## Why work for us?
The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.
The pay range for this position is between $110,000 - $140,000 annually, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. description:
## ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
## AI-First Growth Marketer
Location: Remote – Costa Rica
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Financial Services / Private Lending / Real Estate Financing
Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month

## About the Role
We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.
As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.
## Why This Opportunity?
Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing
Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents
Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost
A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans
## What You'll Do
## CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)
Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers
Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume
Clean data safely, with backups and test runs before any bulk change
## Tracking, Attribution & Live Reporting
Capture first- and last-touch source from WordPress (Gravity Forms) into the CRM without either being overwritten
Own UTMs, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Microsoft Clarity
Build live dashboards on lead quality, AI mentions, traffic, form submissions, broker sign-ups, referral sources and funded loans; no manual reports

Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent
Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages
Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements
## Social Media & Community
Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar
Lightly manage the existing reviews setup
## AI Content & Sales Enablement
Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI
Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats
Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out
## Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads
Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns
Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools
Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel
## Qualifications
## Required Qualifications
AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself
3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term
Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)
Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot
GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership
SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress
Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities
Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva
Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them
Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook
C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours
## Preferred Qualifications
Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans
Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel
## Direct mail campaign experience
Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations
Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor
## Candidate Evaluation Considerations
To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:
Concrete examples of AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built
Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth
Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations
Accuracy and judgment when reviewing AI output and data
Autonomy, speed of learning and clear communication in English
## How Success Is Measured
By Day 14: Productive in the tools, with the first quick wins shipped.
By Day 30: CRM, website and tracking audited; a 6-month plan approved; at least 3 quick wins live.
By Day 90: First- and last-touch source captured on every new lead; a live baseline dashboard running; borrower and broker nurture plus a monthly newsletter in place.
By Day 180: Targets set for qualified leads and broker sign-ups; SEO/AEO program running; weekly community posting with leads tracked; at least one direct mail campaign tested.
After Month 6: Success is judged by growth in qualified borrower and broker leads and funded loans from marketing.
## Why Join Us
Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender
Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner
Visible, measurable impact on company growth
## Important Notes
This is a hands-on execution role: no decks, long strategy documents or waiting for direction
Advanced AI use is the core of this role, not a nice-to-have
Agency or freelance project work alone does not count toward the experience requirement
Lending experience is not required; learn the industry with AI and be productive by week two
No coding needed, but you must understand automations and APIs well enough to diagnose issues and direct AI
This is a full-time, exclusive position: no other clients, freelance work or side jobs

title: C Developer Intern (remote work)
description:
We are seeking talented and motivated C Developer Interns to join our TuxCare team. As an intern at TuxCare, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in C development and contribute to the development of our innovative projects.
TuxCare offers a portfolio of security solutions for Linux and open-source software aimed at enterprise organizations. With TuxCare, enterprises can automate live vulnerability patching, minimize downtime, keep their applications secure and compliant, and get support from a team that knows Linux security best – covering the most popular Linux distributions, end-of-life systems, programming languages, and much more. For more information, visit our website: .
This internship is currently open within our Endless Lifecycle Support (ELS) team:
Endless Lifecycle Support (ELS) is one of TuxCare’s key products, enabling organizations to securely continue using Linux distributions and software languages that have reached end of life or no longer receive standard security updates. ELS delivers vulnerability patches for unsupported versions of CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian, and Oracle Linux, as well as for runtimes and frameworks such as PHP, Python, Spring, Angular/AngularJS, Django, and Flask.
More details: .
## In this role, you will:
• Review and validate patches for C and systems code, including fixes produced by our automation and AI tools
• Handle the hard cases automation can’t: tricky backports, corner cases and failing builds
• Research CVEs and backport security fixes to older package versions
• Build and maintain packages across RPM- and DEB-based distributions
• Process tickets and help unblock reviews
• Use AI coding assistants every day and learn to check their output critically
This is a remote internship opportunity, allowing you to work from anywhere and have a flexible schedule.
If you are a passionate individual interested in gaining practical experience in C development and contributing to meaningful projects, we would love to hear from you!
Apply now and kick-start your career with TuxCare!
## Requirements
## What we’re looking for:
• Hands-on C experience: you can read, debug and reason about C / systems code
• Comfortable with GNU/Linux, the command line and shell scripting
• Experience using Git for development and patch/branch management
• Solid fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
• Comfortable using AI coding assistants day-to-day: good prompting, and you can spot when the output is wrong
• English at B2 level or above
• Proactive and able to work independently
## Nice to have:
• RPM or DEB packaging experience
• CVE research or security patching
• Debugging with GDB and strace
• Broad awareness of the AI-assisted development landscape: different models for different tasks, common tooling
## Benefits
## What's in it for you?
• A focus on professional development;
• Interesting and challenging projects;
• Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide;
• Paid vacation, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves;
• Compensation for private medical insurance;
• Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement;
• Budget for education;
• The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent;
• Learn AI-assisted development workflows across the full development lifecycle, from CVE research and backporting to code review
By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy ( ), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handl e your data.

Job Description:
Own your opportunity to turn data into measurable outcomes for our customers’ most complex challenges. As an AI/ML Engineer SME at GDIT, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact, grow your expertise to power your career forward, and seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program for the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC).
GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The AI/ML Engineer SME will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance Team responsible for delivering integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill the AOUSC's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM Program.
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering advanced analytics, visualizations, statistical modeling, and AI/ML capabilities -- including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, predictive models, forecasting, and advanced analytics that provide data-driven decision-support tools and actionable insights to users and stakeholders of the CMM application. This role provides technical leadership, strategic guidance, and tool recommendations to accelerate product development, and improve decision automation and overall CMM products. The role also oversees design, development, integration, and continuous enhancement advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities in alignment with strict federal compliance requirements.
THE AI/ML ENGINEER SME WILL EXECUTE THE FOLLOWING RESPONSIBILITIES
## AI/ML & Advanced Analytics
• Define and execute AI/ML strategy aligned to CMM modernization objectives.
• Design, develop, deploy, and maintain ML, predictive, forecasting, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced analytics solutions.
• Build and tune models using appropriate algorithms, architectures, and data pipelines.
• Develop LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent automation capabilities.
• Apply statistical and advanced analytics methods to support data-driven decision-making.

title: Software Engineer, Agent
description:
## About us
At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
## What you’ll do
Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.
Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.
Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.
Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.
## Example projects
These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:
Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn
Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations
Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!
Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development
Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers
## What you'll bring
Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems
Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments
A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship
Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems
Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences
## Even better...
Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production
Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed
Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering
Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go
Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders
## Our values
Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.
## What we offer
We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
Flexible (unlimited) paid time off
Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family
Life insurance and disability benefits
Retirement plan dependent on country of employment
Parental leave
Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized
Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most
Free alphorn lessons
These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
## Be you, with us
We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.
Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.
We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.
Why we’re hiring
We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.
You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.
We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.
Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.
What we're looking for
You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.
Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.
A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.
Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.
Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.
Probably not for you if
You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.
The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.
Working at Odin
Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in the UK with quarterly trips to London.

Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments
Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave
Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options
Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)
Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally
Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

description:

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.
In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:
Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.
OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.
Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.
Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.
Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.
Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.
## Qualifications:
Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.
Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python
Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.
Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.
Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.
Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers
Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.
Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.
Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.
Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.

Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.

Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.
Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.
Contexte du stage
Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».
Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.
Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.
Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.
Votre mission :
L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.
Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.
Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.
Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :
• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore
• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise
• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.
Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel.
Informations importantes
ð Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ;
ð Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.
Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.
Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty.
Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.
About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027.
What you will do
Data pipeline
Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them
Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use
Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets
Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters
Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from
Collaboration and sharing
Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team
Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it
What we're looking for
We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.
Core qualifications
Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university
Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship
Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases
Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment
Comfortable with open-ended problems where the answer is not known yet, and able to compare technical options and explain your reasoning, both in writing and in front of a team
Nice to have
Experience with a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Flyte, Argo Workflows)
Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Spark, Dask)
Experience with Kubernetes
Experience working with robotics or sensor data (point clouds, camera streams, time-series data) and formats such as ROS bags or MCAP
Experience with data versioning or dataset management tools (e.g., DVC, lakeFS)
This role is a great fit if…
You are eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world problems, and to see your work having an impact on actual machines
You want to contribute to a foundational data pipeline that helps our machines improve faster
You thrive in a hands-on environment where you learn new tools by trying them out on real data
You are curious about machine learning and about how training datasets are built
You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism

We are an international team working to solve problems with global impact. To facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

title: Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
Job Description
Machine Learning Engineer to join the Predictive Operations Squad. The engineer will build geographical data science systems to improve SingPost’s delivery network efficiency for all three legs of delivery: last mile, middle mile and first mile. The Senior ML Engineer will develop data pipelines, run workload forecasting models, visualize and optimize delivery routes on maps across the postal and logistics network, and suggest improvements to delivery points. The role will require travel to logistics, post office sites and POPStations in Singapore to work closely with delivery teams including postmen and drivers.
Key Responsibilities
Route Optimization
• Workload Rebalancing - Identify routes with imbalanced workloads and find new ways of rebalancing workload to reduce costs.
• Route Optimisation - Run routing algorithms like Google OR-Tools, Google Map Routes API or CuOpt to find the best route for delivery.
Map & AI
• Map AI Agent - Explore innovative techniques to reduce delivery costs using Google Map AI Agent and evaluate delivery statistics like delivery cost per parcel and on-time delivery rate.
• Map Visualization App - extract mail and parcel data from machines, edge devices and BigQuery into a map for visualization. Analyze the data on the map with AI or ML models.
PDPA & Data Governance
• PDPA - Handle confidentiality of personal data by ensuring apps, data pipelines and data stores follow internal policy for Personal Data Protection Act.
• Data Governance - Ensure data is properly stored within Singapore residency, properly document data lineage and prevent data leaks by following appropriate cyber security policies.
Requirements
• 5+ years in machine learning engineering or data science, with at least 2 years delivering production ML systems end-to-end (not exclusively research or PoC work)
• Able to use Python AI / ML engineering libraries scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, and at least one of PyTorch or TensorFlow.
• Able to write clean, tested, version-controlled code besides using JupyterLab/Jupyter Notebook
• Experience using WebGL mapping libraries to render multilayer map layers and visualize large numbers of pins on a map efficiently.
• Experience in deploying Web Apps into production environments.

Our client is a Singapore-based professional services firm that primarily provides outsourced accounting and business support services. They are seeking a hands-on and forward-thinking System Support Engineer to oversee daily IT operations while driving the adoption of AI and automation solutions across the organisation.
This role combines IT infrastructure management, cloud-based systems support and AI implementation. You will work closely with different departments to understand their workflows, identify opportunities for automation and introduce practical technology solutions that improve productivity, streamline processes and reduce manual tasks.

IT Support & Infrastructure

• Troubleshoot and resolve daily IT issues to ensure smooth business operations.
• Manage IT equipment inventory, including the setup, configuration and deployment of computers and other devices.
• Maintain IT infrastructure, cloud-based systems and network connectivity.
• Ensure regular data backups and support disaster recovery procedures.
• Assist in maintaining IT security standards and PDPA compliance.
AI Enablement & Digital Transformation
• Identify opportunities to improve business processes through AI tools, automation and emerging technologies.
• Engage with different departments to understand existing workflows and identify repetitive or manual tasks suitable for automation.
• Evaluate, recommend and implement suitable AI applications and cloud-based solutions.

• Conduct pilot programmes, demonstrations and training sessions to encourage AI adoption across the organisation.
• Gather user feedback and monitor the effectiveness of AI initiatives through productivity improvements, time savings and error reduction.
• Provide ongoing guidance and technical support to employees adopting new AI technologies.
Vendor & Project Coordination
• Liaise with external IT vendors, service providers and system integrators to resolve technical issues.
• Coordinate IT-related projects, system enhancements and technology implementations.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and other IT projects as assigned by Management.
Requirements
• Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cloud Computing or a related discipline.
• Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in IT support, system administration, cloud infrastructure or related IT functions.
• Hands-on experience troubleshooting computer hardware, software, Windows operating systems, servers, printers and network connectivity.
• Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, DHCP and basic network administration is an advantage.
• Good understanding of generative AI tools and their practical applications in business operations.
• Ability to analyse business processes and translate operational requirements into practical AI and automation solutions.
• Experience implementing cloud-based AI solutions such as Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AWS AI services or similar platforms.
• Familiarity with APIs and scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell will be an advantage.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
• Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and handle projects effectively.
• Proactive, service-oriented and meticulous, with a strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
